Common questions

What are the Milwaukee Brewers' playoff odds?

They reach the 2026 postseason in better than 99% of 10,000 simulated finishes, win the NL Central in better than 99%, earn a first round bye in better than 99% and win the World Series in 22%.

How many games will the Milwaukee Brewers win?

They are 93 and 57 with 12 games left. The model expects about 6.8 more wins, and eight of every ten simulated finishes end between 98 and 102 wins.

How are the Brewers rated?

From runs scored and allowed: 778 scored and 583 allowed, a run differential of +195, turned into a Pythagorean record and pulled toward .500 by 70 games of average play. That rates them as a .590 team, and each game uses log5 with a home field edge.
